warmups.name: Kneeling Ankle Mobility
warmups.precautions: Half-kneeling, front foot flat a few inches from a wall or block;Drive the front knee forward over your toes, heel glued down;Rock in and out slowly;Stop if the ankle pinches at the front
warmups.cues: Half kneel, heel down;Drive knee over toes;Rock slowly

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise Machine
exercises.precautions: Balls of feet on step edge, heels lower than toes;Legs straight but knees never locked hard;Rise straight up - no bouncing at the bottom;Body tall - shoulders under pads, no leaning
exercises.cues: Shoulders under pads, feet at edge;Rise onto toes high;Lower heels below step, slowly

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.precautions: Balls of feet on platform, pad rests on lower thighs;Knees bent ~90 degrees and still throughout;Rise straight up on toes - no rocking;Full stretch at bottom - pause before rising
exercises.cues: Sit tall, pad on thighs;Raise heels as high as you can;Lower slowly to full stretch

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
exercises.precautions: Ball of one foot on step edge, hold rail for balance;Standing leg straight, knee soft - not locked;Rise straight up - hips level, no leaning away;Lower heel below step slowly, no bounce
exercises.cues: One foot on step, hold support;Rise onto toes tall;Lower slowly, repeat, switch

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raises
exercises.precautions: Hold a chair back or wall lightly for balance;Feet hip-width, toes pointing forward;Rise straight up - do not roll your ankles outward;Lower slowly until your heels touch the floor
exercises.cues: Hold support, stand tall;Rise onto your toes;Lower slowly, repeat

exercises.name: Pogo Jumps
exercises.precautions: Small springy hops on the balls of your feet;Knees stay nearly straight - the bounce comes from the ankles;Stay tall and light;Keep hops low, rhythm steady
exercises.cues: Bounce from the ankles;Small, quick, light;Stay tall

exercises.name: Deep Squat Heel Raises
exercises.precautions: Hold a block or support and sit into your deepest squat;Raise both heels, then lower them, without standing up;Stay in the squat the whole set;Use support generously - balance is not the exercise
exercises.cues: Stay deep in the squat;Heels rise and lower;Hold support as needed

exercises.name: Downward Dog Calf Walk
exercises.precautions: In downward dog, bend one knee and press the other heel toward the floor;Alternate like pedalling;Keep hips high and back long;Never force the straight heel down
exercises.cues: Hips high in down dog;Pedal the heels alternately;Back stays long

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.precautions: Land on the balls of your feet, soft and quiet;Keep jumps low - just enough for the rope to pass;Turn the rope with your wrists, shoulders relaxed;Rest the moment your form gets sloppy
exercises.cues: Light bounces, rope skims the floor;Steady rhythm, breathe easy;Stay tall and relaxed

exercises.name: Ankle Rolls
exercises.precautions: Stand tall, holding support if you need it;Roll the ankle in a full, slow circle;Keep the movement smooth and pain-free;Do both directions on both sides
exercises.cues: Lift one foot slightly;Circle the ankle slowly;Reverse direction, switch sides

stretches.name: Standing Calf Stretch
stretches.precautions: Move gently until you feel a mild stretch - never force;Breathe slowly and relax into it - no bouncing;Keep posture tall and supported where you can
stretches.cues: Move gently to a mild stretch;Breathe slowly, never force it
